concepts.label: consumer protection
concepts.definition: Legal rules that protect buyers of goods and recipients of services from unfair or unsafe practices.

concepts.label: consumer
concepts.definition: A person who buys goods or hires services for consideration and personal use.

concepts.label: consumer complaint
concepts.definition: A formal allegation by a consumer about goods, services, or a trader's conduct.

concepts.label: refund
concepts.definition: The return of money paid for goods or services.

concepts.label: defect
concepts.definition: A fault, imperfection, or shortcoming in goods or a product.

concepts.label: deficiency
concepts.definition: A shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature, or manner of performance of a service.

concepts.label: service
concepts.definition: A service of any description made available to potential users, including facilities related to banking, insurance, transport, and housing.

concepts.label: unfair trade practice
concepts.definition: A trade practice that adopts unfair or deceptive methods to promote goods or services.

concepts.label: restrictive trade practice
concepts.definition: A trade practice that prevents, distorts, or restricts competition.

concepts.label: misleading advertisement
concepts.definition: An advertisement that falsely describes a product or service or creates a misleading impression.

concepts.label: product liability
concepts.definition: Liability of a product manufacturer, seller, or service provider for harm caused by a defective product or deficient service.

concepts.label: consumer dispute
concepts.definition: A dispute between a consumer and a trader, manufacturer, or service provider about goods or services.

concepts.label: e-commerce
concepts.definition: Buying or selling goods or services through electronic or digital networks.

concepts.label: competition law
concepts.definition: Legal rules that promote and sustain competition in markets and prohibit anti-competitive conduct.

concepts.label: enterprise
concepts.definition: A person or body engaged in the production, distribution, or provision of goods or services.

concepts.label: dominant position
concepts.definition: A position of strength that lets an enterprise operate independently of competitive forces or affect competitors and consumers.

concepts.label: abuse of dominant position
concepts.definition: Anti-competitive conduct by an enterprise that holds a dominant position in a market.

concepts.label: agreement
concepts.definition: An arrangement or understanding between enterprises, whether formal or informal.

concepts.label: cartel
concepts.definition: An association of producers, sellers, or service providers that limits competition through coordinated conduct.

concepts.label: merger
concepts.definition: The combination of two or more enterprises into one entity or group.

concepts.label: acquisition
concepts.definition: The purchase or taking of control over the whole or part of another enterprise.

concepts.label: enforcement
concepts.definition: The process of implementing, monitoring, and securing compliance with legal requirements.

concepts.label: penalty
concepts.definition: A financial or other sanction imposed for a breach of legal requirements.

concepts.label: appeal
concepts.definition: A request to a higher authority or court to review a decision.

concepts.label: Tribunal
concepts.definition: A body established to adjudicate specified disputes or appeals.

concepts.label: dispute resolution
concepts.definition: Processes for resolving disagreements outside ordinary litigation.

concepts.label: mediation
concepts.definition: A voluntary process in which a mediator helps parties reach a settlement.

concepts.label: mediator
concepts.definition: A neutral person who facilitates communication and settlement in mediation.

concepts.label: food safety
concepts.definition: Legal requirements and controls that ensure food is safe and fit for human consumption.

concepts.label: food business
concepts.definition: An undertaking involved in the manufacture, processing, storage, distribution, or sale of food.

concepts.label: standardisation
concepts.definition: The process of establishing and applying standards for products, processes, and services.

concepts.label: standard
concepts.definition: A documented requirement, specification, or guideline used to ensure quality or safety.

concepts.label: licence
concepts.definition: A formal permission granted to carry on an activity subject to legal conditions.

concepts.label: legal metrology
concepts.definition: Legal control of weights, measures, and measuring instruments used in trade and commerce.

concepts.label: railway
concepts.definition: The railway system, including railway administration, trains, tracks, and related services.

concepts.label: passenger
concepts.definition: A person travelling or intending to travel by railway or another mode of transport.

concepts.label: transport
concepts.definition: The movement of goods or persons from one place to another.

concepts.label: carrier
concepts.definition: A person or entity that undertakes to transport goods or passengers.

concepts.label: compensation
concepts.definition: Payment or other redress for loss, injury, or damage.

concepts.label: certification
concepts.definition: Formal confirmation that a product, process, or service meets specified standards.

concepts.label: hallmark
concepts.definition: An official mark confirming that an article meets a prescribed standard, especially for precious metals.

concepts.label: manufacturer
concepts.definition: A person or entity that makes or produces goods.

concepts.label: seller
concepts.definition: A person or entity that sells or offers goods for sale.

concepts.label: product
concepts.definition: An article or substance manufactured, produced, or offered for sale.

concepts.label: inspection
concepts.definition: Official examination of premises, goods, records, or processes to check compliance.

concepts.label: search and seizure
concepts.definition: The legal power to search premises or things and take possession of evidence or contraband.

concepts.label: offence
concepts.definition: A violation of law that may lead to prosecution or other legal consequences.

concepts.label: punishment
concepts.definition: A sanction imposed on a person for committing an offence.

concepts.label: insurance
concepts.definition: A contract under which an insurer agrees to indemnify the insured against specified losses.

concepts.label: baggage
concepts.definition: Personal belongings carried by a passenger during travel.

concepts.label: multimodal transport
concepts.definition: Carriage of goods under a single contract using more than one mode of transport.

concepts.label: Director General
concepts.definition: A statutory officer with investigation or enforcement responsibilities under an Act.

concepts.label: adjudicating officer
concepts.definition: An officer empowered to adjudicate specified contraventions and impose penalties.
